steps.label: :android: SDK tests and example build
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home
export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
"$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" "platform-tools" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0" "ndk;29.0.14206865" "cmake;3.22.1"
source scripts/bazel/ci-cache.sh
export NUXIE_BAZEL_JOBS=2
export NUXIE_BAZEL_BIN="$(python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "scripts/bazel"); import launcher; print(launcher.executable())')"
scripts/bazel/sdk.sh test
scripts/bazel/sdk.sh build
scripts/bazel/sdk.sh example
scripts/bazel/sdk.sh instrumentation
scripts/bazel/sdk.sh prepare --output build/maven-repository
./gradlew --no-daemon --max-workers=2 :nuxie-android:test :nuxie-android:apiCheck :nuxie-android:lint
./gradlew --no-daemon --max-workers=2 verifyAndroidReleaseArtifacts
python3 scripts/test-maven-consumer.py --version "$(python3 -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "scripts/bazel"); import sdk; print(sdk.declared_version())')"
scripts/verify-fixtures.sh
